info.name: KU HOME API
info.description:
# 🏨 KU HOME API — Postman Collection

Comprehensive API testing suite for KU HOME hotel management REST API (Laravel 13, PHP 8.3+, Sanctum 4).

### 🔑 Authentication & Token Flow
- Default authentication uses Bearer Token `{{token}}`.
- Login requests auto-populate `{{admin_token}}`, `{{user_token}}`, `{{housekeeping_token}}`, and active `{{token}}`.

### 🛡️ Global Middleware
- Every `/api/*` request must include `Accept: application/json` (enforced via `RequireJsonAccept`).
- File viewing `GET /images/{id}/file` uses Signed URL and accepts `image/*`.
